name: Strategy-ready reproducible research slice
inputs: offline retained historical bars with explicit instrument, venue, interval and time range
an immutable saved strategy revision containing entry, exit and risk rules
documented deterministic execution and cost assumptions
outputs: inspectable trade ledger, P&L, drawdown and core performance metrics
minimal backtest result, trade-list and equity-chart UI
replay_contract: The same retained-data identity, strategy revision and execution assumptions reproduce the same backtest identity and deterministic outputs.
failure_contract: Missing, stale, unauthorized or non-reproducible inputs fail closed without claiming a completed experiment.
public_path: Historical-data import -> immutable strategy revision -> backtest configuration -> result overview -> trade list -> equity chart.
offline_assumptions: No live broker, credential or real-provider qualification is required for the first offline milestone.
Mocked or component-only evidence never proves real-provider behavior.
timebox_policy: The desired four-to-eight-hour timebox is not evidence of feasibility. Re-estimate from prepared packets for the remaining closure; never redefine V3 completion to fit it.
